svg.text: Every interface between SUS-I1 and the 8 external entities it touches, numbered as in the table. Two-headed arrows are two-way interfaces.
Generated by tools/figures/architecture_readme.py from architecture/item-definition.yaml, safety/hazards/ and requirements/. Concept-stage item definition (status draft): not a baseline.

g.text: Terms: EXT-AIRSPACE = external element: airspace, people and property under the UAV · EXT-BYSTANDER = external element: bystanders · EXT-CREW = external element: ground crew and maintainers · EXT-GNSS-RF = external element: GNSS and RF environment ·

EXT-OBSERVER = external element: safety observer · EXT-PILOT = external element: pilot · EXT-TERRAIN = external element: terrain and obstacles · EXT-WEATHER = external element: weather · GNSS = global navigation satellite system (GPS and similar) · GPS =

Global Positioning System · IF-nnn = interface in the item definition (architecture/item-definition.yaml) · RF = radio frequency · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SUS-A1-NAV = navigation sensors, camera and telemetry · SUS-I1 = integrated mechanized

walker and observation UAV · SUS-M1-PIL = pilot station, restraints, displays and controls · SUS-M1-PWR = power generation, storage, distribution and thermal control · SUS-M1-SAF = independent safety monitor, protective stop and isolation · SUS-M1-WLK =
chassis, legs, joint actuators and stability sensing · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
